## Sentry
Issue **APPLE-IOS-Y** (weaive / apple-ios): crash when `startRunning` is called **between** `beginConfiguration` / `commitConfiguration` inside `CameraController.run`.

- Volume: **1 event / 1 user**, build **12**
- Related fresh camera hangs today: APPLE-IOS-3 / 11 / V (CameraPreviewView hangs, build 12)

## Ownership
**Lane 3 owns `Camera/*` — don’t duplicate.** Fold into Lane 3 camera work; do not open a parallel agent on the same files.

## Why it matters
Even at 1 event, begin/commit misuse is a classic AVFoundation footgun and can become a crash spike. Pair with today’s CameraPreviewView hang signals on build 12.
